message:
- **We pull it**, Instructions: Entra ID → App registrations → New registration → Certificates & secrets → New client secret, then Storage account → Access control (IAM) → Add role assignment → grant that app Storage Blob Data Reader, Storage File Data Privileged Reader, Storage Table Data Reader, Storage Queue Data Reader, and Reader. Send the tenant ID, client ID, secret and storage account name to us by secure means, never plaintext email or chat; if the account has a firewall, also allowlist our egress IPs under Networking.

Let me know if you would prefer to push this!
notes: Pull coverage follows the data roles granted to the app registration.
A storage firewall without our egress IPs blocks the pull entirely.
